lines.zh: 我从竞技场那头走过来，石板在脚下响。
lines.en: I cross the arena and the flagstones ring.
Three strides and I am almost on you.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，沙地被踩出印子。
lines.en: I lift a foot and leave a print in the sand.
I walk the edge of my arena.
My cloak drags behind me.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，血条就亮一下。
lines.en: Each step I take makes the health bar flare.
No hurry; this arena is mine.
I cross the cracks without pausing.
I am locating you.

lines.zh: 我站在场中央，一直在等。
lines.en: I stand at the center, waiting.
A health bar hangs above me.
I was not asleep; I was waiting.
The pattern on the tiles glows.
I do not watch you, only the arena.
I turn my wrist and listen to the joints pop.

lines.zh: 这座竞技场，我守了很久。
lines.en: I have guarded this arena a long time.
The moment you entered, I woke.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己脚下的圆。
lines.en: I look down at the circle under me.
I smell the ki on you.

lines.zh: 我的影子把光都挡住了。
lines.en: My shadow blocks the light.
I step inward once more.
There are no spectators here, only me.
I touch the railing beside me.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，脖子上的环在响。
lines.en: I look down; the rings on my neck clink.
You stand straight.
This arena lets you in, not out.
I have waited a long time.
In the arena, I wake.
There is a little courage in you.

lines.zh: 我抬起下巴，看清你的脸。
lines.en: I lift my chin and read your face.

lines.zh: 别以为我睡着就好对付。
lines.en: Do not think me easy because I slept.
I know that manner of walking.
Did you just step back?

lines.zh: 我不说话，可比说话更清楚。
lines.en: I say nothing, which says more.
The blow knocks my head aside.
The flagstone breaks under me.

lines.zh: 我退半步，脚跟踩碎石板。
lines.en: I step back and my heel crushes a tile.
This wound is worth a fight.
I wipe the blood away.
My ki holds.
I smile, and that should frighten you.
You can actually hurt me.
I straighten my cloak.
Good; now I am serious.

lines.zh: 在这座场里，只有一件事要做。
lines.en: In this arena there is only one thing to do.
Put it away.

lines.zh: 我低头闻了闻，别开了脸。
lines.en: I lower my head, sniff, and turn away.
I am no beast.
That will not buy your life.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，像在喂牲口。
lines.en: You hold out food as if feeding livestock.
Those are not allowed at the center.

lines.zh: 挑战者带来的东西？放下。
lines.en: A challenger's gift? Set it down.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，弹了回去。
lines.en: You bounce off me.
My bracer grazes your head.
You should step aside.
The flagstone crushes under me.
That collision will hurt.
I turn and my cloak sweeps you.
Our shadows sway together.

lines.zh: 场地就这么大，躲不开的。
lines.en: The arena is only so big; you cannot dodge.
There is no second one in this arena.

lines.zh: 我守着这里，不需要同伴。
lines.en: I guard this place; I need no companion.
My duty ends here.
I look up at the dome.
I rest a hand on the platform edge.
I have waited alone too long.
The arena will remain.
Half the pattern under my feet dims.
I stand straight again.
Is that not cheating?
I close it in my grip.
Spoils belong to whoever takes them.
Two fingers are just right for pinching it.
This is of little use to me.
I tuck it into my belt pouch.
You dropped it; I will not refuse.
I set it on the platform edge.
You stepped into my arena.
I am awake, fully awake.
The health bar lights above me.
I throw my cloak aside.
There is no halftime here.
When I strike, it is decided.
You cannot run past this wall.
I count to two and the floor tiles crack.

lines.zh: 我醒了，竞技场就该热闹。
lines.en: I wake, and the arena stirs.

lines.zh: 你是这一千年里第一个。
lines.en: You are the first in a thousand years.
My ki lifts the sand.

lines.zh: 这座竞技场，我睡了很多年。
lines.en: In this arena I have slept for years.

lines.zh: 一千年才等来你，别太弱。
lines.en: A thousand years for you; don't be weak.
This arena has waited for you.
I am moving now.
I close in slowly, each step steady.

lines.zh: 石板一块块碎在我脚下。
lines.en: Flagstones shatter under my feet.
Wherever you go, I hold the center.
My ki sweeps the whole arena.
You look for a way out; there is none.
I raise a hand and sand rises.

lines.zh: 残影拳，你分不清哪个是我。
lines.en: Afterimages—you cannot tell which is me.
I knew you would run here.
There is a wall behind you.
Prey always tires.

lines.zh: 我抬手，沙尘绕着手指转。
lines.en: I raise a hand and sand spins around my fingers.
The arena is shrinking, for you.
I heard you misstep.
I am waiting for despair.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，我还在走近。
lines.en: You back to the wall, and I keep coming.
You are about to look up.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸地，冲击波扫开。
lines.en: I punch the floor and a shockwave spreads.
My fist grazes your cheek.
I kick a flagstone loose.
You block, but you slide far.

lines.zh: 竞技场的地砖，被我踩裂。
lines.en: The arena tiles crack under me.
That blow carried wind with it.

lines.zh: 我的护腕撞在甲上，很响。
lines.en: My bracer clangs on your armor.
Listen; the wall is shaking.
Before you rise, I am there.
Seven tenths of my strength there.
I step back and let you rise.
Can your bones still hold?
I raise a hand and the floor splits.

lines.zh: 竞技场的门开了，我走进来。
lines.en: The arena gate opens and I walk in.
The health bar surfaces above me.
One flagstone trembles.

lines.zh: 我落座在王座边，现在站起。
lines.en: I sat by the throne; now I stand.
The stands are empty.
I was placed here to wait for you.

lines.zh: 我的影子覆盖了半个场地。
lines.en: My shadow covers half the arena.
Sand falls from the dome.
I stretch both arms and the joints pop.
The circle at the center lights up.
I lift my head and watch you enter.
The air is thick with dust.
I rise and the floor sinks.
I measure your height.

lines.zh: 拳头一握，石缝里冒出灰。
lines.en: I clench my fist and dust puffs from the seams.

lines.zh: 我从王座边站起，沙落下来。
lines.en: I rise from the throne side and sand falls.

lines.zh: 我从台座后走出来，脚步压着石缝。
lines.en: I step out from behind the dais, feet finding the seams.

lines.zh: 这一圈地砖，我认得每一块。
lines.en: I know every tile in this ring.

lines.zh: 火在我披风上烧，我扯掉它。
lines.en: Fire catches my cloak and I tear it off.

lines.zh: 我从高台落下，落地砸出坑。
lines.en: I drop from the high platform and crater the ground.
Water floods the arena and I hold my breath.
The blast flips flagstones; I stand.

lines.zh: 箭扎在我肩上，我拔了出来。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder and I pull it out.
Spell-light burns through one sleeve.

lines.zh: 不知多久没吃东西，我还在撑。
lines.en: I cannot recall my last meal, and I still hold.

lines.zh: 雷落在我头顶，我仰头看它。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my head and I look up at it.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，我抓住台边。
lines.en: Nothing under my feet; I grip the platform edge.
